mapper.select: select plan_id from user_plan_selections where user_id = #{userId}

select p.id, p.title, p.sessions_per_week, p.description, count(pi.id) course_count from training_plans p left join training_plan_items pi on pi.plan_id = p.id where p.active = true group by p.id, p.title, p.sessions_per_week, p.description, p.sort_order order by p.sort_order, p.id
